Room 7. A bare bulb, a dripping IV, the smell of ointment on burns. Tomas REIS sat up when he saw you come in; the movement cost him.

The nurse stays in the doorway. "Five minutes. He hasn't slept since they came the first time."
REIS regarde le papier sans le lire. « J: REIS looks at the paper without reading it. "I don't know, Inspector. I don't know what's true any more, with everything they've made me sign."
Ses épaules descendent un peu. « Ma femm: His shoulders drop a little. "My wife is in Brenec, at her sister's. Nobody told her. If you go past the post office..." He doesn't finish. For the first time he looks at you as a person, not a uniform.
"Tell me about that night, from the beginning."
« La n° 2 sifflait depuis l'automne. La: "No. 2 had been whistling since autumn. We'd asked for the valve, RUDA asked for it ten times. At two o'clock he called to shut it down. They told him no. After that... I remember the noise. That's all."
« Vous avez signé une déposition à 4 h d: "You signed a statement at 4 in the morning."
Il fixe le drap. « À quatre heures ? Je: He stares at the sheet. "At four? I don't remember four o'clock. I remember waking up, it was daylight, there was a paper on the bedside table with my name on it."
« La silhouette près de la chaudière : q: "The figure near the boiler: who was it?"
« Quelle silhouette ? » Puis il comprend: "What figure?" Then he understands, and his face closes. "The SEDLAR girl? She wrote down the pressure in her notebook, every hour, for RUDA. She was the one saying it was getting too high. You're going to pin it on her?"
« Qui est entré dans votre chambre, cett: "Who came into your room that night?"
Il baisse la voix, regarde la porte. « D: He lowers his voice and looks at the door. "Two men. Not doctors. One held my hand for the signature, the other said: 'The captain wants a signature before the bulletin.' I heard it like under water. I couldn't say no, I couldn't say anything."
« Vous savez ce que coûte un faux témoig: "Do you know what false testimony costs?"
REIS se met à trembler. « Je maintiens !: REIS starts to shake. "I stand by it! I stand by everything I signed!" The monitor races. The nurse comes in, takes you by the arm without a word and pushes you into the corridor. The door closes.
Il lit la fiche médicale lentement, en r: He reads the medical chart slowly, moving his lips. "Not fit for questioning before ten." He puts the sheet down. "So at four I was asleep. So it wasn't me who spoke."
Le registre des visites, les deux passag: The visitors' log, the squad's two visits. REIS closes his eyes. "Twice. Yes. One of them said the captain wanted a signature before the bulletin."
